'''Tau/Zeiss''' was a company known for its excellent optics.

It was most famous for its Tau/Zeiss [[telescopic sniperscope]], which could hold true from a range of 1x to 100x. The company went out of business roughly [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]].
